items.text: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) now likely to miss Sunday vs Colts in London despite Q tag; sources indicate miss.
items.why: Late hamstring; multiple sources say miss.
items.implication: Commanders WR void with Mariota; Diggs etc. rise.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip issue; expected to play per Schefter. Levitan notes possible snap limits on return.
items.why: Cleared injury report as IN; Schefter expected to play, Donald OUT same team.
items.implication: WR1/2 floor with potential volume cap; boosts Rams passing if full.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if unlimited; monitor snap share early.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans (ribs) game-time decision. Evans intends to play through it per Rapoport/reports.
items.implication: If plays, limited effectiveness possible; else CMC/Kittle heavy.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring. Also Goedert and Baun out; Eagles situation worse per Levitan.
items.implication: Hurts Eagles passing attack significantly; volume to others.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson out Sunday due to sprained ankle. Corroborated across reports.
items.implication: Major WR void; shifts targets heavily.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) QUESTIONABLE; went LP-DNP-LP. Already dealt with cracked rib this season.
items.opportunity: If out, Chargers WR targets to Johnston/others.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) IN; excellent spot vs Cowboys who inflate opp WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL. Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: Return + elite DvP and game script.
items.opportunity: High target share expected in favorable matchup.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity with Justin Jefferson out; home vs borderline NFL secondary. Moment Addison truthers waited for.
items.why: Jefferson OUT creates clear target vacuum in good matchup.
items.implication: WR2/flex with WR1 upside this week.

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT (with Smith and Baun). Eagles without three key players vs Rams.
items.why: Listed OUT on ETR Sunday report; Schefter confirms.
items.opportunity: Backup TE or WR targets rise.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT. Listed among key OUTs for Sunday.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup leads.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); tough month: lost GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, Charbonnet back practicing. Still eye-test positive long-term.
Ravens QB Lamar Jackson off injury report and good to go Sunday vs Titans.
Omarion Hampton on Week 4 Hate List due to low usage concerns.
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better options.
items.conflict: Conflicts with any high-upside projection if usage stays low.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play; 90% snaps with Dowdle out, believes in usage despite short week risks.
items.why: High snap share and opportunity with teammate out.
